an6.6:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an6.6:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājāniyo khamo hoti rūpānaṃ khamo saddānaṃ khamo gandhānaṃ khamo rasānaṃ khamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ balasampanno ca hoti
an6.6:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājāniyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an6.6:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an6.6:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti rūpānaṃ khamo saddānaṃ khamo gandhānaṃ khamo rasānaṃ khamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ khamo dhammānaṃ
an6.6:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti. 7
